query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as tem_permissao
FROM role_permissions rp
JOIN custom_roles cr ON rp.role_id = cr.id
WHERE cr.name = 'manutenção' 
AND rp.module = 'manutencoes' 
AND rp.submodule IS NULL;
